questions_and_answers.question: Conversation 1 — A: いらっしゃいませ。お客様ですか。 (Irasshaimase. Okyakusama desu ka?) B: 見ているだけです。 (Mite iru dake desu.) Did the customer buy the merchandise?

answers.answer: No — the customer was just looking.
Yes — the customer bought a book.
Yes — the customer bought a camera.

questions_and_answers.question: Conversation 2 — A: すみません、この本を下さい。 (Sumimasen, kono hon o kudasai.) B: かしこまりました。千八百円でございます。お待たせ致しました。二百円でございます。毎度ありがとうございます。 (Kashikomarimashita. Sen happyaku-en de gozaimasu. Omatase itashimashita. Nihyaku-en de gozaimasu. Maido arigatoo gozaimasu.) What did the customer buy and how much was it?
Conversation 2 (continued) — Did the customer receive change, and how much?

Conversation 3 — The customer asks to see a camera, asks the price (三万二千円 = 32,000 yen), asks if there's a cheaper one, the clerk offers one for 二万九千円 (29,000 yen), and the customer buys it, handing over 三万円 (30,000 yen). What did the customer buy and for how much?
Conversation 3 (continued) — The clerk says 千円のお返しでございます (Sen-en no okaeshi de gozaimasu). Did the customer receive change, and how much?

Conversation 4 — A: ちょっと、すみません。もう少し大きいレインコートはありますか。 (Chotto, sumimasen. Moo sukoshi ookii reinkooto wa arimasu ka?) B: ちょっとお待ちください。お客様、あいにくですが、大きいのはございません。 (Chotto omachi kudasai. Okyakusama, ainiku desu ga, ookii no wa gozaimasen.) A: そうですか。じゃあ…… (Soo desu ka. Jaa...) Did the customer buy the merchandise?

answers.answer: No — there was no larger raincoat available, so the customer did not buy.
Yes — the customer bought a raincoat.
Yes — the customer bought a larger one.
Yes — the customer bought a sweater.

questions_and_answers.question: Conversation 5 — A: すみません。そのセーターは、いくらですか。 (Sumimasen. Sono seetaa wa, ikura desu ka?) B: 八千円でございます。 (Hassen-en de gozaimasu.) A: そうですか。赤いのはありますか。 (Soo desu ka. Akai no wa arimasu ka?) B: はい、こちらです。 (Hai, kochira desu.) A: じゃあ、それを下さい。 (Jaa, sore o kudasai.) What did the customer buy and how much?

Conversation 5 (continued) — B: かしこまりました。一万円お預かり致します。お待たせ致しました。二千円のおつりでございます。 (Kashikomarimashita. Ichiman-en oazukari itashimasu. Omatase itashimashita. Nisen-en no otsuri de gozaimasu.) Did the customer receive change, and how much?

articles.text: Directions: Listen to the conversation on the tape twice, aiming for overall understanding. Then fill in the chart while listening to the tape again. For each conversation, determine: Did the customer buy the merchandise? What did the customer buy? How much did it cost? Did the customer receive change?
